title: Mechanistic insights into the base-catalyzed hydrolysis of PCDDs via QSAR and DFT approaches
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5VA00397K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Kun Xie, Haiqin Zhang
The influence of ELUMO, polarizability, and molecular volume on the base-catalyzed hydrolysis rate of PCDDs was revealed. It provided a theoretical foundation for predicting the hydrolysis rate of organic pollutants.
